people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Hadadezer
people.line: King of Zobah, defeated by David.

people.name: Syria
people.line: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict

people.name: Zobah
people.line: An Aramean kingdom, enemy of Israel during David's reign

translations.web: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.
translations.bsb: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand of their men.
translations.kjv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
translations.asv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succor Hadarezer king of Zobah, David smote of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
